arxiv-2205-03545.title: Generalization of multivariable Laplace transform based on Tsallis q q -exponential and its inverse using Post-Widder’s method
arxiv-2205-03545.creator: Naina Mohammed Samu Shahabuddin, Jeevanandham Karthikeyan, Basherrudin Mahmud Ahmed Abduljaffer, Md. Manirul Ali, Chandrashekar Radhakrishnan
arxiv-2205-03545.description: Abstract A generalization of the multivariate Laplace transform based on the Tsallis q q -exponential is given in the present work for a new type of kernel. We also define the inverse transform for this generalized multivariate transform based on the complex integration method.

arxiv-2304-13148.title: Introducing MBIB - the first Media Bias Identification Benchmark Task and Dataset Collection Conference: Proceedings of the 46th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 23–27, 2023; Taipei, Taiwan Proceedings of the 46th International ACM SIGIR C
arxiv-2304-13148.creator: Martin Wessel, Tomáš Horych, Terry Ruas, Akiko Aizawa, Bela Gipp, Timo Spinde
arxiv-2304-13148.description: Abstract . Although media bias detection is a complex multi-task problem, there is, to date, no unified benchmark grouping these evaluation tasks. We introduce the Media Bias Identification Benchmark (MBIB), a comprehensive benchmark that groups different types of media bias (e.g., linguistic, cognitive, political) under a common framework to test how prospective detection techniques generalize.

arxiv-2405-04601.title: Predictions for the abundance and clustering of H α \alpha emitting galaxies.
arxiv-2405-04601.creator: Makun S. Madar, Carlton M. Baugh, Difu. Shi
arxiv-2405-04601.description: Abstract We predict the surface density and clustering bias of H α \alpha emitting galaxies for the Euclid and Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope redshift surveys using a new calibration of the GALFORM galaxy formation model. We generate 3000 GALFORM models to train an ensemble of deep learning algorithms to create an emulator.

arxiv-2407-09640.title: Bayesian inference of covariate-parameter relationships for population modelling
arxiv-2407-09640.creator: Han Cheng Lie
arxiv-2407-09640.description: Abstract We consider population modelling using parametrised ordinary differential equation initial value problems (ODE-IVPs). For each individual drawn randomly from the unknown population distribution, the corresponding parameters for the ODE-IVP cannot be measured directly, but a vector of covariates is given, and one component of the solution to the corresponding ODE-IVP is observed at a fixed finite time grid.

arxiv-2412-04609.title: Tuning towards the edge of a dark abyss: Implications of a tuning paradigm on the hierarchy between the weak and dark matter scales
arxiv-2412-04609.creator: Christopher D. Carone, Noah L. Donald
arxiv-2412-04609.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Christopher D. Carone, Noah L. Donald. It has recently been suggested that tuning towards the boundary of the positivity domain of the scalar potential may explain the separation between the electroweak scale and the unification scale in a grand unified theory. Here we explore the possibility that the same type of tuning might account for the generation of the electroweak scale from a much lighter dynamically generated scale in a dark sector.

arxiv-2502-08089.title: A Cooperative Bearing-Rate Approach for Observability-Enhanced Target Motion Estimation
arxiv-2502-08089.creator: Canlun Zheng 1,2 , Hanqing Guo 2 , Shiyu Zhao 2
arxiv-2502-08089.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Canlun Zheng 1,2 , Hanqing Guo 2 , Shiyu Zhao 2. Vision-based target motion estimation is a fundamental problem in many robotic tasks. The existing methods have the limitation of low observability and, hence, face challenges in tracking highly maneuverable targets. Motivated by the aerial target pursuit task where a target may maneuver in 3D space, this paper studies how to further enhance observability by incorporating the bearing rate information that has not been well explored in the literature.

arxiv-2503-15657.title: The S-PLUS Fornax Project (S+FP): Mapping globular clusters systems within 5 virial radii around NGC 1399 Facilities: S-PLUS
arxiv-2503-15657.creator: Luis Lomelí-Núñez, A. Cortesi, A.V. Smith Castelli, M. L. Buzzo, Y.D. Mayya, Vasiliki Fragkou, J. A., Alzate-Trujillo, R. F. Haack, J.P. Calderón, A. R. arxiv-2503-15657.description: Abstract We present the largest sample ( ∼ \sim 13,000 candidates, ∼ \sim 3000 of wich are bona-fide candidates) of globular cluster (GCs) candidates reported in the Fornax Cluster so far. The survey is centered on the NGC 1399 galaxy, extending out to 5 virial radii ( R vir R_{\textrm{vir}} ) of the cluster.

arxiv-2512-15260.title: Two-Body Kapitza–Dirac Scattering of One-Dimensional Ultracold Atoms
arxiv-2512-15260.creator: A. Becker, G. M. Koutentakis, P. Schmelcher
arxiv-2512-15260.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by A. Becker, G. M. Koutentakis, P. Schmelcher. Kapitza–Dirac scattering, the diffraction of matter waves from a standing light field, is widely utilized in ultracold gases, but its behavior in the strongly interacting regime is an open question. Here we develop a numerically-exact two-body description of Kapitza–Dirac scattering for two contact-interacting atoms in a one-dimensional harmonic trap subjected to a pulsed optical lattice, enabling us to obtain the numerically exact dynamics.

pmc-10535988.title: Transcriptomic and Physiological Analysis Reveals Genes Associated with Drought Stress Responses in Populus alba × Populus glandulosa
pmc-10535988.creator: Tae-Lim Kim, Hyemin Lim, Michael Immanuel Jesse Denison, Changyoung Oh, Michael Moustakas, Anelia Dobrikova
pmc-10535988.description: Drought stress affects plant productivity by altering plant responses at the morphological, physiological, and molecular levels. In this study, we identified physiological and genetic responses in Populus alba × Populus glandulosa hybrid clones 72-30 and 72-31 after 12 days of exposure to drought treatment.

pmc-10758617.title: Biomaterial-assisted local oxygenation safeguards the prostimulatory phenotype and functions of human dendritic cells in hypoxia
pmc-10758617.creator: Khushbu Bhatt, Alexandra Nukovic, Thibault Colombani, Sidi A. Bencherif
pmc-10758617.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Dendritic cells (DCs), professional antigen-presenting cells, function as sentinels of the immune system. DCs initiate and fine-tune adaptive immune responses by presenting antigenic peptides to B and T lymphocytes to mount an effective immune response against cancer and pathogens. However, hypoxia, a condition characterized by low oxygen (O2) tension in different tissues, significantly impacts DC functions, including antigen uptake, activation and maturation, migration, as well as T-cell priming and proliferation.

pmc-11325807.title: Development of quality indicators for hypertension, extractable from the electronic health record of the general practitioner: a rand-modified Delphi method
pmc-11325807.creator: Katrien Danhieux, Marieke Hollevoet, Sien Lismont, Pieter Taveirne, Lotte Van Vaerenbergh, Bert Vaes, Steve Van den Bulck
pmc-11325807.description: BackgroundHypertension, a chronic medical condition affecting millions of people worldwide, is a leading cause of cardiovascular diseases. A multidisciplinary approach is needed to reduce the burden of the disease, with general practitioners playing a vital role. Therefore, it is crucial that GPs provide high-quality care that is standardized and based on the most recent European guidelines.

pmc-11391080.title: Double dissociation of visuomotor interaction mediated by visual feedback during continuous de novo motor learning
pmc-11391080.creator: Junghyun Kim, Sungbeen Park, Kwangsun Yoo, Sungshin Kim
pmc-11391080.description: While the sensorimotor cortices are central neural substrates for motor control and learning, how the interaction between their subregions with visual cortices contributes to acquiring de novo visuomotor skills is poorly understood. We design a continuous visuomotor task in fMRI where participants control a cursor using their fingers while learning an arbitrary finger-to-cursor mapping.

pmc-12470472.title: A Randomized Trial on the Benefits of Refitting Symptomatic Contact Lens Wearers with Daily Disposable Lenses
pmc-12470472.creator: José Miguel Sánchez-Ruiz, A. Eusebio López-Hernández, Youssef Abidi, Johnny Di Pierdomenico, Diego García-Ayuso
pmc-12470472.description: Background/Objective: Contact lens discomfort (CLD) is a prevalent issue affecting up to 50% of wearers and contributes to discontinuation in approximately 30% of cases. This study aimed to evaluate the impact of refitting symptomatic monthly replacement contact lens (CL) wearers with a new daily, disposable contact lens (Kalifilcon A DDCL) and to compare its effectiveness against a placebo CL.

pmc-12486653.description: BackgroundChronic inflammatory arthritis, including rheumatoid arthritis (RA), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), and spondyloarthritis (SpA), poses unique challenges during pregnancy due to potential maternal and fetal complications. This study aimed to compare pregnancy outcomes among women with these conditions in Qatar.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted at Hamad General Hospital from 2016 to 2022. pmc-12525248.title: AI-Integrated QSAR Modeling for Enhanced Drug Discovery: From Classical Approaches to Deep Learning and Structural Insight
pmc-12525248.creator: Mahesh Koirala, Lindy Yan, Zoser Mohamed, Mario DiPaola, Francisco Torrens, Jesús Vicente de Julián-Ortiz
pmc-12525248.description: Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) with the Quantitative Structure-Activity Relationship (QSAR) has transformed modern drug discovery by empowering faster, more accurate, and scalable identification of therapeutic compounds. This review outlines the evolution from classical QSAR methods, such as multiple linear regression and partial least squares, to advanced machine learning and deep learning approaches, including graph neural networks and SMILES-based transformers.

pmc-12561323.title: Regulatory of Oleuropein on the In Vitro Maturation of Oocytes and the Development of Parthenogenetic Embryos in Sheep
pmc-12561323.creator: Yue Zhang, Wenjuan Zhao, Zihao Ma, Zhenghang Li, Zhijiao Liu, Pengcheng Wan, Guangdong Hu, Gianluca Neglia
pmc-12561323.description: Simple SummaryOleuropein, as an antioxidant, can alleviate the oxidative stress phenomenon during the in vitro culture of sheep oocytes and early embryos, thereby improving embryo quality. This study found that the appropriate addition of oleuropein can increase the maturation rate of oocytes and promote the development of early embryos.

pmc-12566775.title: Understanding Callus Types in Maize by Genetic Mapping and Transcriptional Profiling
pmc-12566775.creator: Guifang Lin, Yan Liu, Tej Man Tamang, Yang Qin, Mingxia Zhao, Jun Zheng, Guoying Wang, Hairong Wei, Sunghun Park, Myeong-Je Cho, Frank F White, Yunjun Liu, Sanzhen Liu, Shri Mohan Jain
pmc-12566775.description: Plant transformation efficiency is highly dependent on species, individual genotypes, and tissue types. In maize, immature embryos are regularly used for transformation. The process relies heavily on callus development, as it is intricately associated with somatic embryogenesis and subsequent plant regeneration, both of which directly affect transformation efficiency.

pmc-13087080.title: Diagnosis and embolization of a non-iatrogenic and non-traumatic thyrocervical pseudoaneurysm
pmc-13087080.creator: Qian Yang, Amit Ramjit
pmc-13087080.description: Non-traumatic and non-iatrogenic pseudoaneurysms of the thyrocervical trunk are exceedingly rare. We report a case of a 63-year-old man with esophageal cancer who presented with fever and worsening chronic cough following initiation of induction chemotherapy. Computed tomographic angiography demonstrated a 1.3 cm pseudoaneurysm arising from the thyrocervical trunk.
